name: cavemio-settings-form
title: Settings form
description: A settings page that saves the way people expect: switches save themselves, text edits gather into one bar that rises with "2 unsaved changes".

cavemio.accessibility:
- Toggles are role="switch" buttons labelled by their field label and described by its description. Choices are radio groups: arrows move and select, and only the selected option is in the tab order.
- Every message under a field is linked to its input with aria-describedby, and inputs with errors are aria-invalid. Saves, refusals and resets are announced in a status region; the "Saving" beside a label is for the eye only.
- ⌘S or Ctrl+S saves while focus is in the form. The bar is a sticky footer: on a long page it stays at the bottom of the window while the form is in view.
- A newer change to a switch wins: an older answer that arrives late is ignored. Edits made while a save is running stay unsaved and keep the bar open.
- Text inputs use 16px type on touch screens so phones don't zoom into them.
- Reduced motion changes everything in place: no thrown thumbs, slides, swells or shakes; the words and colours still say what happened.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: sections
props.description: – · Groups of fields. A field is { type: "toggle" | "choice" | "text" | "textarea", name, label, description? } plus options for a choice and placeholder, prefix, rows, maxLength, validate, check and checkPassed for text.

props.name: value
props.description: – · Saved values, controlled. Edits live in the form until they're saved.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · The saved values after every successful save.

props.name: onSave
props.description: – · Saves just the changed values (one field for a switch, every edit for the bar). Return what was stored; throw an Error to show its message, or SettingsFormError(message, { field: reason }) to put reasons under fields.

props.name: autosave
props.description: true · Toggles and choices save the moment they change. Set false to send them with the bar like text.

props.name: warnOnLeave
props.description: true · Asks before the page unloads while there are unsaved edits.

props.name: field.validate
props.description: – · Refuses a text value before it's sent; the message opens under the field.

props.name: field.check
props.description: – · An async check run 450ms after typing stops. Return null when the value is fine or the reason it isn't; a taken value can't be saved.

features.title: Switches save themselves
features.description: The thumb is thrown across, “Saving” opens beside the label, then a check draws and fades.

features.title: Refusals are visible
features.description: If your server says no, the thumb is thrown back with a shake and the reason opens under it.

features.title: Text edits gather into one bar
features.description: A bar rises with “2 unsaved changes”. Save or ⌘S sends only what changed.

features.title: Checks as you type
features.description: A field can ask your server whether a value is free, shortly after typing stops, and cancels older checks.

features.title: Server errors go under their fields
features.description: Throw SettingsFormError and each reason opens under its field, with focus on the first.

features.title: Reset and leave warnings
features.description: Reset blurs the edits back to what was saved, and leaving with unsaved edits asks first.

states.title: switch
states.description: A toggle's thumb is thrown 16px with a slight overshoot (420ms); a choice's thumb slides to the option. "Saving" opens beside the label (the column eases open in 380ms) with a spinner, then a check draws and "Saved" fades after 1.6s.

states.title: refused
states.description: If onSave throws for a switch, the thumb is thrown back, the control shakes ±4px and the message opens under the field; "Not saved" stays beside the label for 2.4s.

states.title: edit
states.description: Typing in a text field swells a dot beside its label (overshoot, 420ms) and opens the bar at the foot of the form by height; its count rolls as more fields change and the label morphs between change and changes.

states.title: check
states.description: 450ms after typing stops, check() runs: a spinner sits at the end of the field and "Checking" lifts in under it, then a drawn check and "Available", or the reason in red with a red thin line. A newer keystroke cancels the older check through its AbortSignal.

states.title: save
states.description: Save (or ⌘S / Ctrl+S anywhere in the form) runs validate() for each changed field first; refusals shake their fields and the bar says how many need a look. Then onSave gets only the changed values; the button says Saving, then Saved, and the bar folds away 1.1s later.

states.title: server errors
states.description: Throw SettingsFormError(message, { field: reason }) and each reason opens under its field, the field shakes, the bar shows the message and focus moves to the first field with an error.

states.title: reset
states.description: The changed fields blur from 20% back to their saved values in 420ms; their dots shrink away and the bar folds.
